main.description: Assert ONE disclosed financial line item (:fin.fact/*) into the kotoba Datom log, linked to its :fin.filing and a CANONICAL concept (normalized across JP-GAAP / US-GAAP / IFRS). Records what the company DISCLOSED — kanjō is NON-ADJUDICATING (G2) and gives NO investment advice / NO rating / NO forecast (G4). A restatement (訂正) is asserted as a NEW fact with supersededBy on the prior one; the original Datom is RETAINED (非終末論, G11).

statement.description: 貸借対照表 / 損益計算書 / キャッシュフロー / per-share

concept.description: CANONICAL concept (concept_map). ordinary-income (経常利益) is JGAAP-only — do NOT cross-compare across standards

conceptRaw.description: the SOURCE taxonomy element the concept was mapped from, e.g. "jppfs_cor:NetSales", "us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss", "ifrs-full:Revenue" (audit, G5)

value.description: disclosed magnitude as an INTEGER in `scale` units of `unit` (implied units — mirrors the filing verbatim when :authoritative). For per-share / ratio concepts (eps) the value is an implied ×100 minor unit (sen / basis points) to stay integer

context.description: 連結 / 単体 — consolidated preferred for comparison

supersededBy.description: → :fin.fact/id of a later :teisei (restatement) fact, when this figure was corrected. FORWARD pointer only — the original Datom is retained (G11)

sourcing.description: G5; :synthesized is NOT permitted for a disclosed fact (only for :fin.metric / :fin.agg)
